info.name: EventDrivenMesh
info.description:
Complete, runnable API collection for the EventDrivenMesh microservices project (Spring Boot + Kafka saga).

Base URL is the API Gateway: http://localhost:8080. All real endpoints live under /api/v1/**.

DEMO CREDENTIALS (already provisioned in auth_db):
  email    : creditskumar@gmail.com
  password : Test@1234
Run "Login" first to store accessToken / refreshToken / userId into collection variables — the Gateway injects X-User-Id / X-Trace-Id from the JWT automatically.

PAYMENT FLOW (manual initiate — saga waits at PAYMENT_PROCESSING):
  1. Place an order.
  2. "Initiate Payment" — set {{gateway}} = MOCK (instant dev success) or RAZORPAY (real Razorpay order via your keys from .env).
  3. "Verify Payment" — for RAZORPAY replace {{gatewayPaymentId}} with the real razorpay_payment_id from the checkout popup; leave gatewaySignature empty (dev mode). For MOCK keep defaults.
  Alternative: hosted checkout UI http://localhost:8083/index.html (Order ID + Customer ID, pick gateway, Pay Now).

For a one-click end-to-end demo, open the "Saga Flow (run in order)" folder and use the Collection Runner in order.

Notes:
  - Analytics has no gateway route; its folder uses directBase (http://localhost:8093).
  - /api/v1/auth/** has no JWT filter, so "Get Current User" sends X-User-Id manually.
  - Logging and Seller-Admin require a ROLE_ADMIN token.
  - Product/category names & SKUs are unique — edit bodies before re-running to avoid conflicts.

item.name: Saga Flow (run in order)
item.description:
One-click end-to-end demo. Run this folder top-to-bottom with the Collection Runner (add a small delay step between Place Order and Get Order by loading the runner with fixed delay).

Flow: Login → Category → Product → Inventory → Place Order (triggers Kafka saga: order → inventory → payment → shipping → notification) → poll Order Status → verify Payment / Shipment / Notifications → download Invoice PDF.

exec: console.log('KAFKA SAGA TRIGGERED: order-events -> inventory -> payment -> shipping -> notification');
console.log('INFO: saga-auto-process=false, so payment waits for manual initiation.');
console.log('Next: run 7. INITIATE PAYMENT then 8. VERIFY PAYMENT. Final status after ship: SHIPPED');
console.log('Gateway session:', g.status, '| order:', g.gatewayOrderId, '| key:', (g.gatewayKey||'').substring(0,12) + '...');
console.log('RAZORPAY optional: open http://localhost:8083/index.html with this Order ID to pay via popup');

item.name: Orders
item.description: Order management and the Kafka saga entry point (order-service).

request.description: Places an order and starts the saga: ORDER_CREATED → inventory reserve → payment → shipping → notification. totalAmount is computed from item prices.
Event-sourced journey: ORDER_CREATED → INVENTORY_CHECKING → INVENTORY_RESERVED → PAYMENT_PROCESSING → PAYMENT_COMPLETED → ORDER_SHIPPED.
All events sharing one correlationId (set {{correlationId}} from the history response).
Server-Sent Events stream that pushes status updates live (text/event-stream).

Debug endpoint: directly advance an order to a status. Values: PENDING, INVENTORY_CHECKING, INVENTORY_RESERVED, PAYMENT_PROCESSING, PAYMENT_COMPLETED, SHIPPING_PROCESSING, SHIPPED, COMPLETED, CANCELLED, FAILED.

item.name: Payments
item.description: Payment initiation, verification, refunds and the Razorpay webhook (payment-service).

exec: console.log('Checkout session ready:', g.status, '| gatewayOrderId:', g.gatewayOrderId);
console.log('RAZORPAY: open the hosted checkout http://localhost:8083/index.html (or use the checkout key below)');

request.description:
Creates the gateway checkout session for the current order. Set the collection variable {{gateway}} to:
  - MOCK    → instant dev success (Verify Payment with defaults).
  - RAZORPAY → real Razorpay order/session created server-side with your .env keys; the response gatewayKey + gatewayOrderId drive the Razorpay checkout popup (or the hosted UI at http://localhost:8083/index.html). Then Verify Payment with the real razorpay_payment_id.
  - STRIPE  → same init flow, needs real Stripe keys.

Captures the payment against the gateway session. MOCK: keep {{gatewayPaymentId}} default. RAZORPAY: set {{gatewayPaymentId}} to the razorpay_payment_id from the checkout popup; gatewaySignature can stay empty (dev-mode skip) or hold the real HMAC signature.
Full refund if amount is omitted or equals the payment amount; partial refund otherwise.
Payment-service proxies the order from order-service via Eureka.
Called by Razorpay directly — no JWT (high-limit, signature-verified endpoint).
